name: rgm
description: Work RGM bug reports as a coding agent: the tester's report and its translation, the screenshots, a way to ask the reporter when the report is unclear, and a way to hand the fix back with the test that proves it.

interface.shortDescription: Work the bugs your testers filed
interface.longDescription: Fetch a project's unresolved bug reports, read the tester's own words beside the translation, look at the screenshots, ask the reporter when the report does not add up, comment what changed, and hand the bug back as fixed-awaiting-verification with the test that proves it.
defaultPrompt: Work the unresolved RGM bugs in this project, one at a time.
